strings.d1.theme: Midtown: Empire State, Bryant Park, Times Square
strings.d1.s0.name: Top of the Rock
strings.d1.s0.tips: Rockefeller Center's observation deck: the best view of the Empire State Building. Timed tickets (~47 USD); clearest in the morning.
strings.d1.s1.name: St. Patrick's Cathedral
strings.d1.s1.tips: Neo-Gothic cathedral on Fifth Avenue; free entry.
strings.d1.s2.name: Ess-a-Bagel
strings.d1.s2.tips: A proper New York bagel: everything bagel with scallion cream cheese. The queue moves fast.
strings.d1.s3.name: New York Public Library & Bryant Park
strings.d1.s3.tips: The Rose Main Reading Room is free; take a lunch break in the park.
strings.d1.s4.name: Times Square
strings.d1.s4.tips: Best after dark, when the lights are on. Buy discounted same-day Broadway tickets at TKTS.
strings.d1.b0.name: Empire State Building
strings.d1.b0.tips: The 86th-floor deck; the classic alternative to Top of the Rock.
strings.d1.b1.name: Los Tacos No. 1 Times Square
strings.d1.b1.tips: Adobada tacos (marinated pork); the best quick bite in Times Square.
strings.d2.s0.name: Statue of Liberty Ferry Battery Park
strings.d2.s0.tips: The first Statue City Cruises ferry leaves at 08:30 (~26 USD, pedestal access included). Ellis Island has an immigration museum. Book crown tickets months ahead.
strings.d2.s1.name: 9/11 Memorial
strings.d2.s1.tips: The twin tower pools; free to visit, museum ~33 USD.
strings.d2.s2.name: Oculus & Westfield World Trade Center
strings.d2.s2.tips: Calatrava's white station; great for photos.
strings.d2.s3.name: Joe's Pizza Broadway
strings.d2.s3.tips: New York slice pizza: fold it and eat it standing up.
strings.d2.s4.name: Brooklyn Bridge Walk
strings.d2.s4.tips: Walk from Manhattan to Brooklyn across the bridge in 30 minutes, then head to DUMBO for sunset.
strings.d2.b0.name: Staten Island Ferry
strings.d2.b0.tips: A free ferry: see the Statue of Liberty from the water without going up to the pedestal.
strings.d2.b1.name: Eataly Downtown
strings.d2.b1.tips: An Italian food market at the World Trade Center.
strings.d3.s0.name: Central Park South Tour
strings.d3.s0.tips: Bethesda Terrace, Bow Bridge and Strawberry Fields; rowing boats in summer.
strings.d3.s1.name: The Metropolitan Museum of Art
strings.d3.s1.tips: The Egyptian temple, Vermeer and the American Wing. 30 USD for visitors from outside New York; allow at least 2 hours.
strings.d3.s2.name: Levain Bakery Upper West Side
strings.d3.s2.tips: Giant cookies, right by Central Park.
strings.d3.s3.name: American Museum of Natural History
strings.d3.s3.tips: Dinosaurs and the blue whale; ~28 USD for visitors from outside New York.
strings.d3.b0.name: Shake Shack Upper West Side
strings.d3.b1.name: Guggenheim Museum
strings.d3.b1.tips: Frank Lloyd Wright's spiral; an alternative to the Natural History Museum.
strings.d4.s0.name: DUMBO Washington Street
strings.d4.s0.tips: The classic Manhattan Bridge view; no crowds in the morning.
strings.d4.s1.name: Brooklyn Bridge Park
strings.d4.s1.tips: A riverside park with Jane's Carousel and the Manhattan skyline.
strings.d4.s2.name: Juliana's Pizza
strings.d4.s2.tips: Coal-oven pizza in DUMBO from the original Grimaldi's pizzaiolo. Opens at 11:30.
strings.d4.s3.name: Williamsburg Bedford Avenue
strings.d4.s3.tips: Vintage shops, record stores and cafes; take the L train.
strings.d4.s4.name: Domino Park
strings.d4.s4.tips: A riverside park on a former sugar refinery site, with Manhattan sunsets.
strings.d4.b0.name: Smorgasburg
strings.d4.b1.name: Brooklyn Heights Promenade
strings.d4.b1.tips: A scenic walkway in front of the brownstone houses.
strings.d5.theme: High Line, Chelsea and Greenwich Village
strings.d5.s0.name: The High Line
strings.d5.s0.tips: A park on a former railway line; walk from Gansevoort Street to 34th Street. Quiet in the morning.
strings.d5.s1.name: Chelsea Market
strings.d5.s1.tips: A food market in the old Nabisco factory; try Los Tacos No. 1 and a lobster roll.
strings.d5.s2.name: Whitney Museum of American Art
strings.d5.s2.tips: American art, plus terraces with views of the High Line.
strings.d5.s3.name: Washington Square Park
strings.d5.s3.tips: The arch and street musicians; NYU's neighbourhood.
strings.d5.s4.name: Greenwich Village Walk
strings.d5.s4.tips: Bleecker Street, the Friends building and a Magnolia Bakery cupcake.
strings.d5.b0.name: Joe's Pizza Carmine Street
strings.d5.b0.tips: The original Joe's, in the Village.
strings.d5.b1.name: Little Island
strings.d5.b1.tips: An artificial island park over the river; an alternative to the Whitney.
strings.d6.s0.name: Coney Island Boardwalk
strings.d6.s0.tips: 1 hour by subway; the boardwalk, the Cyclone (~10 USD) and the Wonder Wheel.
strings.d6.s1.name: Nathan's Famous Coney Island
strings.d6.s1.tips: Hot dogs since 1916; home of the famous eating contest.
strings.d6.s2.name: Coney Island Beach
strings.d6.s2.tips: Swim in the Atlantic; bring a towel and sunscreen.
strings.d6.s3.name: New York Aquarium
strings.d6.b0.name: Totonno's Pizzeria
strings.d6.b1.name: Brighton Beach
strings.d6.b1.tips: The beach of the neighbouring Russian district.
strings.d7.theme: Lower East Side: a gentle farewell
strings.d7.s0.name: Russ & Daughters
strings.d7.s0.tips: Lox and bagels since 1914; the perfect farewell breakfast.
strings.d7.s1.name: Tenement Museum
strings.d7.s1.tips: A guided tour of an immigrant tenement building; book ahead.
strings.d7.s2.name: Little Italy Mulberry Street
strings.d7.s2.tips: Cannoli (at Ferrara) and the Italian quarter.
strings.d7.s3.name: Chinatown Canal Street
strings.d7.s3.tips: Souvenirs and dim sum; try Nom Wah Tea Parlor.
strings.d7.s4.name: Penn Station / AirTrain
strings.d7.s4.tips: AirTrain plus LIRR to JFK takes 45 minutes; time to say goodbye.
strings.d7.b0.name: Clinton St. Baking Company
strings.d7.b0.tips: Pancake breakfast, instead of Russ & Daughters.
strings.d7.b1.name: New Museum
strings.note0: The subway costs 3 USD with OMNY contactless; after 12 rides in a week, further rides are free. Get to JFK by AirTrain plus LIRR or the E train; a taxi is a flat 70 USD.
strings.note1: Museums: the Met is 30 USD for visitors from outside New York, the Natural History Museum 28 USD, MoMA 30 USD; many offer 'pay what you wish' on certain days.
strings.note2: Summers are humid, 28-33°C: head to Coney Island and the riverside parks, and Broadway in the evening. There are fireworks on 4 July.
strings.note3: Tip 18-22% in restaurants and 1-2 USD per drink at bars; prices exclude tax (8.9%).
strings.note4: Bagels, slice pizza, pastrami and halal carts: 5-15 USD; a sit-down meal is 30+ USD.
strings.note5: Book the first Statue of Liberty ferry and crown tickets months ahead; Top of the Rock tickets are timed.
strings.transit.name: OMNY (contactless)
strings.transit.why_chosen: Pay 3 USD per ride on the subway and buses with a contactless card; after 12 rides in a week, the rest are free
